The '''Hunter's Blind''' was a region of the [[High Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison]]. It was used to incarcerate [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] prisoners, and was the site of a [[Trandoshan vault|Rakatan vault]].
